purpose: Prospective perceptual loss study; legacy acceptance is retained and separately reported.
cutoff_note: Preregistered nearest native band boundary to proposed 1500 Hz; not a proven physical threshold.

objective.asymmetry: multiply squared log-energy error by overshoot_weight when predicted energy exceeds target
objective.swedish_bandwidth_mask: exclude bands crossing 8000 Hz from spectral loss for native 16kHz rows; report them separately
objective.sequence: actual native inverse basis, 120-sample OLA, clamp PCM; include lost burst and first received frame; FFT sizes128/256/512, hop quarter; mean normalized magnitude L1 plus log-magnitude L1; exact native identity-gain parity required

selection.checkpoint: minimum experiment validation objective among QAT epochs11..60
selection.best_loss_for_2D: minimum balanced validation perceptual score: normalized low-band error + 0.1 masked log-band-energy MSE + 0.1 sequence MR-STFT; compute common score for all variants
selection.final_candidate: best validation score including 2D, once; no retry after acceptance results

acceptance.reference: installed 60-epoch MLP, plus classical PLC and unchanged legacy gate
acceptance.cpu_note: compare native overhead, existing first-loss DSP variability documented; not a new worst-case claim

evaluation.acceptance_selection: deterministic SHA256 snacka-step2-acceptance-v1:path, first unused held-out clip per group; exclude every prior oracle clip. EN speaker groups; SV sentence groups with UNKNOWN speaker disjointness; no independent Swedish-speaker claim.

limitations: Future-target oracle does not establish a causal ceiling or remaining learnable headroom.
Existing Swedish speech is16kHz; full-band Swedish quality is unproven.
Objective scores are not blind listening evidence.
CU cost is measured after sessions stop, not predicted from epochs.
